high_level_description: stc brand style, a woman in a lavender abaya using her smartphone beneath an ornate stone archway at sunset, with a man walking in the background.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A sandstone building with an ornate carved archway and a decorative arched doorway, lit by a warm pink and orange sunset sky.

A man wearing a red-and-white checkered ghutra and a white thobe, walking in the background near the archway.
